group_manifest.proof_strategy: Open or split xizi_dll once around the queried member, preserve all fields, and fold the unchanged representation on returns. Select the full-resource left disjunct for each return witness. For node_next=head derive an empty suffix and return 0; for node_next<>head expose a cons suffix and return node_next; for the sentinel cases use the analogous whole-segment endpoint/nonempty split. For the two derived specs instantiate nodes_dispatch_case with the original logical list, establish anchor and dispatch equality by node=head or member-not-head, and prove the ownership-preserving wand using the same xizi_dll resource shape.
expected_helpers: Group-suffixed split/reassembly lemmas proved by induction over the logical prefix.
A group-suffixed member-versus-sentinel disequality lemma; the dispatch equations themselves may be proved inline by unfolding the case_lib definitions.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: If nodes = before ++ node :: after, node is absent from before, and xizi_dll head nodes holds, expose sentinel links, the prefix segment ending at node, node links, and the suffix segment ending at head, together with head/node/node_next non-null and node <> head facts.

premises.premise: nodes = before ++ node :: after and ~ In node before
premises.discharged_by: the standard first-occurrence decomposition of the In node nodes anchor branch

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: Reassemble sentinel links, a prefix segment ending at node, node links, and a suffix segment ending at the sentinel into xizi_dll head (before ++ node :: after).

premises.discharged_by: PreH2 in return_wit_2 and PreH2 in return_wit_3
PreH7/PreH8 in return_wit_2 and PreH7/PreH8 in return_wit_3

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: The guarded segment supplies two reusable consequences: a segment starting at its stop has an empty logical list; a segment whose start differs from the stop has nodes = start :: rest, hence first_value nodes = start. With a non-null stop, its start is non-null in either case.

premises.premise: start = stop or start <> stop, as applicable
premises.discharged_by: the explicit return branch guards, or a case split for the entail witness

premises.premise: stop <> 0 for the general start-non-null consequence
premises.discharged_by: the xizi_dll head non-null conjunct or the explicit PreH head non-null fact

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: In node nodes -> xizi_dll head nodes |-- pure(node <> head), derived from the guarded segment representation and disjoint sentinel/node link ownership.

premises.discharged_by: the anchor member branch or the member_case precondition
